decisions.summary: a line per RETURN in <git common dir>/check-passes.jsonl at SubagentStop or a foreground PostToolUse, nothing pending, apart from the page-check state; subject = the prompt's first line, sanitized
decisions.why: FR-001. Unchanged since round 2. Checked against the clone's own events: 53 agents with SubagentStop events in the clones' l7r-events logs, none with a transcript record timestamped after its last stop, so the cells read at the stop are the whole return's.

decisions.summary: each return of a resumed agent is a pass with its own segment's cells (review_cost.segments splits at each prompt after the first; make review-cost prints a line per return); the same return seen by both events written once
decisions.why: Round 2's NOT LEGITIMATE narrowing is gone: this is now SC-003 / US1 scenario 3 literally (two returns, two entries, each answered by its own row) and FR-002's every logged pass. The repeat-skip collapses only one return seen twice (same agent, same cells), which is not two passes. Re-measured this round: across those 53 agents the segment count equals the stop count for every one (0 mismatches), so a single-return transcript does not split and a resumed one splits per return. The review-cost per-return line serves SC-004 (enforcement).

decisions.summary: CHECKS gains modal-depiction, modal-form, modal-research, source-filter
ledger_owed.py: every logged line a pass (an identical repeat once); answered by check + wall + tokens; prints the row with judgment cells '?'
decisions.why: FR-002/FR-003. The one-pass-per-agent clause round 2 ruled on is replaced; distinct() keys on agent, check and both cells, so it merges only a double sighting.

decisions.summary: report at every commit, refuse at the push with LEDGER_ROWS_OK recorded; make ledger-owed
